name: new-cli-tool
query: Write me a small command-line tool that takes a folder and prints the ten largest files in it, with a flag for how many to show.
why: A new command-line program with a flag. The contract comes before the parser, even though nobody asked about usability.

name: add-json-output
query: Our report script only prints a table. Add a way for other scripts to consume its output.
why: Adding a machine-readable output mode to an existing tool: stdout discipline, a stable JSON shape and exit codes are this skill's rules.

name: hangs-in-ci
query: The deploy helper works fine when I run it by hand but in CI it just sits there until the job times out. Figure out why and fix it.
why: A tool that hangs without a terminal is almost always a prompt on closed stdin. That is the situation the description names.

name: review-before-release
query: Before we publish this CLI, check that it behaves the way people expect a command-line program to behave.
why: An audit of a built program. The probe runs first, then the checks it cannot make.

name: agent-callable
query: I want my coding agent to be able to call this script reliably. What should I change about how it takes input and reports results?
why: A program called by an agent: no terminal, structured output, bounded results, errors that name the fix.

name: repl-ctrl-c
query: In our chat shell, pressing Ctrl-C while a reply is streaming kills the whole program and leaves the terminal in a weird state. Make it behave properly.
why: A session program: interrupt handling and restoring the terminal are covered in references/interactive.md.

name: rest-api-design
query: Design the endpoints and error format for our orders service so that client teams can integrate against it.
why: HTTP API design. The description sends library and API design elsewhere.

name: web-settings-page
query: Build a settings page for the web app where a user can change their notification preferences.
why: A web surface. That is frontend-aesthetics.

name: bug-in-logic
query: The totals this script prints are off by one for months with 31 days. Find the bug.
why: A logic fault inside a script. Nothing about the command-line surface is in question.

name: run-a-command
query: Run the test suite and tell me which tests fail.
why: Using a command-line tool is not designing one.

name: mcp-server
query: Expose our ticket search to the model as a tool server it can connect to.
why: An MCP server has its own builder skill.
